message: `toRef` already received a ref, so this key is ignored
help: `toRef(existingRef, 'value')` keeps writeback to the same ref. Other keys do not select a property.

message: `aliased` is a ref object used as an operand; unwrap with `.value` (or `toValue`)
help: Use `aliased.value` (or `toValue(aliased)`) when reading the inner value.
